title: Localized Calamities & 72-Hour Intimation
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India
text: Individual farm-level losses caused by hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloudburst, and natural fire should be intimated within 72 hours of occurrence.

title: Post-Harvest Losses - 14 Days
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India
text: Coverage is available up to 14 days from harvesting for crops kept in cut-and-spread condition in the field against cyclonic rain or unseasonal rain.

title: Official Reporting Channels
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India
text: Losses may be reported through the Krishi Rakshak Portal and National Helpline 14447; the Crop Insurance Mobile App (with geo-tagged photos); the National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in); the concerned Bank branch (for loanee farmers); or local CSC / Agriculture Department officials.

title: Delayed Intimation Caveat
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India
text: The 72-hour window applies to eligible localized and post-harvest events. Delayed intimations are subject to verification by the competent authority and are not automatically rejected without review.
